newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS STEADY VS DLR/MARK BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS STEADY VS DLR/MARK BASKET.

text.p: The Hungarian forint remained steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket on Wednesday but firmed against the dollar as the U.S. unit weakened against the mark, dealers said.
The forint finished at 198.00/05 to the dollar, compared with 198.40/45 at the opening. The Hungarian unit remained stuck at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
